name: Sit-Up
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet anchored under a bar or pad.
Cross your arms over your chest or rest fingertips beside your head.
Breathe out and curl your upper body up until your chest faces your knees.
Lower back down slowly, one part of the spine at a time.
cues: Do not yank on the neck
Breathe out as you sit up

common_mistakes.mistake: Pulling on the head to get up
common_mistakes.fix: Cross arms on the chest instead
Anchor the feet or switch to crunches
